grammar.summary: 本课学习过去完成时表先于与 forbid 表禁止。

points.title: 过去完成时的先时性
points.explanation: His diet was so strict that he had to reward himself. had to 过去必须；He had never expected... 过去完成表更早的预期。

examples.en: Yesterday, he was rewarded with... he had first mixed them all up.
examples.cn: 昨天他得到了……他先把它们都混在了一起。

points.title: forbid 表禁止
points.explanation: forbid sb. to do / forbid doing 禁止；被动 be forbidden。

examples.en: Herbert has always been forbidden to eat sweets.
examples.cn: Herbert 一直被禁止吃甜食。
